# Godot MCP 0.8.2 vendor archive

This directory preserves the complete upstream Windows AMD64 release archive,
including its bundled `skills/godot-mcp` guidance.

- File: `godot-mcp_0.8.2_windows_amd64.zip`
- SHA-256: `47F8D0E5537ABB71FF8D22253754717C7F7DD9069162242E233FB06B3781270D`
- Source: the release archive supplied locally by the project owner

The unpacked Godot addon is committed under `addons/godot_mcp`. The CLI may be
extracted to `bin/godot-mcp.exe` for local use, but that generated copy remains
ignored so there is only one authoritative vendored binary archive in Git.
